meta.title: Medusa Ledger — Open Source Trust Ledger for Business
meta.description: Open source business trust ledger for verifiable financial and operational events. SHA-256, append-only, Docker quick start.

hero.title: Medusa Ledger — Open Source Trust Ledger for Business
hero.lead: Append-only SHA-256 ledger so anyone can prove business events — without replacing your ERP.

split.title: Core vs Cloud
split.lead: Open the engine. Keep multi-tenant business features commercial.
split.oss_text: Blocks, hashes, events, verify, basic API, Docker, SDK, docs. Free to run locally.
split.cloud_text: Multi-tenant / white-label, payment anchors, analytics hubs, SLA, ERP connectors, hosting.

flow.title: How an event becomes proof
flow.lead: You define the event. Medusa makes it verifiable.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.lead: Clone, compose, post an event, verify the chain.
quickstart.note: Core v0.1 is on the main branch. Demo matches docker compose + curl / CLI from the developer guide.

manual_teaser.title: Usage manual
manual_teaser.lead: Install, API reference, block/tx model, chain verify, and OSS limits.

sponsors.title: GitHub Sponsors
sponsors.lead: Support Core maintenance. Sponsors fund discovery and roadmap — Cloud/Enterprise remain the commercial path.

cta.title: Need hosted multi-tenant?
cta.text: Medusa Cloud runs isolated ledgers per business unit with analytics and payment anchors.
